english.title: Drop / permit to be dropped an article / animal from aircraft in flight so as to endanger persons / property
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of an aircraft in flight, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), from which an

(C)_[article,]_
(D)_[animal,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE OR ANIMAL..), was

(E)_[dropped]_

english.legislation: Contrary to articles 89(1) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
